gaps.quote: Each role stream then holds $V/(2W)$ bits (cited).
gaps.note: Wrong constant. V bits are split evenly among W roles, so each role stream holds V/W bits (paper line 127 and line 1544, volume V/W), not V/(2W).

gaps.quote: Frames therefore pass through every gate, linear or not.
gaps.note: False and inconsistent with the preceding sentences. The commuting identity was derived only for pointwise linear gates, using linearity of the frame and scalar coefficients. The paper (lines 137-138, 812) states it only for pointwise linear gates; it does not hold for nonlinear gates.
